question: Can source-retrieval distillation preserve both retrieval directions while learning supported-caption discrimination, beyond target allocation and weight interpolation?

training.source_loss: original source-only-positive symmetric loss with all hypotheses retained as candidates
training.distillation_teacher: detached frozen image/text scores at frozen native logit scale, divided by T
training.distillation_image_candidates: source-caption columns only within the training image batch
training.distillation_text_anchors: source-caption columns only, each distribution over the images in that batch
training.wise_ft: multiply both learned residual matrices of ordinary supported training by alpha; frozen weights correspond to alpha zero
training.checkpoints: final and running best feasible for each alpha and tolerance; all epoch validation metrics retained

selection.feasibility: each seed's checkpoint must have both source-retrieval directions >= frozen development recall minus tolerance; absolute floating tolerance 1e-12
selection.per_candidate: maximize validation supported-versus-contradicted accuracy among epochs 0 through 10 satisfying both constraints; ties earliest epoch
selection.shared_hyperparameters: within each method family and tolerance choose common learning rate and method parameter across three seeds maximizing mean of their feasible-epoch relation accuracies
selection.shared_ties: lower learning rate then lower beta, source_mix, or alpha as applicable
selection.wise_ft: alpha is shared across seeds and selected jointly with learning rate; per-seed epochs remain validation-selected

evaluation.metrics: same definitions and exact float64 accumulation as frozen original evaluator
evaluation.primary_contrasts: each of five selected families versus frozen, four endpoints: in-domain I2T R1, in-domain T2I R1, visual-entailment accuracy, SugarCrepe++ both accuracy
evaluation.bootstrap: 10000 paired image-cluster resamples after averaging selected seed predictions
evaluation.inference: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided intervals conditional on fitted seeds and fixed candidate gallery
evaluation.practical_retention: report both point differences and adjusted confidence intervals; <=1pp point decline is a point estimate criterion, statistically supported noninferiority additionally requires lower adjusted bound > -1pp
evaluation.sensitivity: 0pp development-selector results reported descriptively with same full endpoints
